entities.identification: A white long-necked goose with an orange beak and webbed feet, walking with its wings spread during the earlier part and folding its wings at the end.

entities.identification: The gray road surface covering the middle and lower portions of the image and extending around the right side of the grass toward the upper right.

entities.name: dark-gray tiled roof
entities.identification: A partially visible dark-gray roof surface at the lower-left edge of the image, with an edge extending diagonally.

entities.name: green median grass
entities.identification: The flat green area in the upper part of the image, with visible boundary corners formed by angled segments.

entities.name: wooden bench
entities.identification: A seat cropped by the upper edge of the image, with a visible brown seat board and dark support underneath.

entities.name: Vehicle A
entities.identification: A partially visible plant cart gradually entering from the right edge of the image, with a dark box-like trough and a red curved-tube frame underneath.

entities.name: black box-bin
entities.identification: The dark square-framed container in the upper right, with crossbars and a dark-blue form visible in its upper part.

entities.name: small light-blue seat-surface object
entities.identification: A partially visible small light-blue angular object on the wooden bench's seat board, cropped by the upper edge.

entities.name: light-colored curb
entities.identification: The narrow segmented beige-gray strip extending along the boundary of the green median grass.

entities.name: group of green plants
entities.identification: A cluster of green branches and leaves extending upward from Vehicle A's box-like trough, with upright stems and laterally projecting leaves.

entities.name: thin gray upright pole
entities.identification: The thin, elongated gray upright pole within the green median grass, image-right of the wooden bench.
